descriptor_definitions.speech_likeness: Fraction of 30ms frames above energy threshold (VAD proxy)
descriptor_definitions.linguistic_content: Whisper-base confidence-weighted word count on background
descriptor_definitions.mod_2to8Hz: Temporal envelope modulation energy ratio in 2-8 Hz band
descriptor_definitions.spectral_overlap: Fraction of spectral energy in 300-3400 Hz
descriptor_definitions.harmonicity: Fraction of voiced frames from pyin F0 estimation

significance_rule: Paired permutation test p<0.05 (Bonferroni-corrected across backgrounds); semantic claims require real>scrambled; energetic claims require SNR-monotone.

metric_definitions.FAR: False-alarm rate on non-target KWS clips
metric_definitions.BIR: Fraction of inserted tokens matching background's own transcript vocabulary
